'''Quarren Town''' was a city located on the [[waterworld]] [[planet]] of [[Mon Cala]]. It was home to a large population of [[Quarren]] and included the [[Quarren headquarters]], which was used as a staging ground for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] during the [[Battle of Mon Cala]].<ref name="Water War" />
